changelog: v43: Forge 1.17+ launch fix — game crashed with 'Could not find or load main class java.base/java.lang.invoke=...' on Forge 1.20.1 / OptiFine (Forge-based installs). JVM arg dedup dropped repeated --add-opens/--add-exports flags and orphaned their values; flag+value pairs are now deduped atomically. Also includes the v42 classpath fix (universal jar kept on classpath).
